falas.78481926: Sky. On top of the clouds, so close to the sun you can feel the warmth. Balloons drift past and rainbow arches turn into gateways along the way.
falas.7675cbee: There we go, now I can talk
falas.c040a648: Uni. the rainbow unicorn. Uni was born at the tip of a rainbow, on a day of sun and rain at the same time. Everywhere she steps turns colorful, and she loves sharing hearts with everyone she meets along the way.
falas.c4b8a296: Sunny. the sunrise unicorn. Sunny wakes up before everybody else to switch the day on. When he gallops he leaves a warm orange and gold trail behind him, and the flowers open as it goes by.
falas.c91da342: power-ups last longer with him. Runs faster on Sky, Fruit and Autumn
falas.2a3fcf84: Luna. the unicorn of the night
falas.043dea10: Luna. the unicorn of the night. Luna only comes out once the sky goes dark, to look after the dreams of everyone asleep. Her trail is a little piece of starry sky, and she knows every shortcut in the night.
falas.2285c96f: she pulls in one item from each lane. Runs faster on Night and Frost
falas.3e9f8269: Ember. the fire unicorn. Ember is the biggest of the bunch, and he runs so fast that his mane catches fire. Where he passes he leaves a path of warm embers that slowly fades away.
falas.53029f7f: he picks up speed much faster. Runs faster on Volcano and Night
falas.18add6a0: Lulu. the baby unicorn. Lulu is the tiniest of the group and is still learning to fly. She is as white as a cloud, and she leaves a thin thread of sparkle wherever she goes.
falas.dc3c7094: she runs with one extra little life. Runs faster on Sky
falas.eb62e20b: Star. the unicorn who fell from the sky
falas.55d19209: Star. the unicorn who fell from the sky. Star fell out of the sky one August night and decided to stay and play. She shines so brightly that the little stars on the track show up just to run along with her.
falas.8f1783d2: stars are worth double for her. Runs faster on Space and Night
falas.8bd726a9: Bubblegum. the bubblegum unicorn. Bubblegum blows bubbles as big as her head and goes bouncing off down the track. When a bubble pops she laughs so much that she has to stop for a breath.
falas.83574cdc: starts every race inside a bubble. Runs faster on Candy
falas.90ca5082: Moss. the forest unicorn. Moss is the calmest of the bunch and knows every tree by name. Wherever he naps in the afternoon, a flower grows the next day.
falas.a1dfc764: his race speeds up very, very slowly. Runs faster on Meadow and Jungle
falas.a16443ee: Wave. the unicorn of the sea
falas.97a9e498: Wave. the unicorn of the sea. Wave was born in the foam of a big wave and never learned how to go slowly. Underwater she is the fastest of them all, and she loves turning up by surprise.
falas.7ae8026b: she runs faster than the track allows. Runs faster on Ocean and Beach
falas.f148a6f7: Snowflake. the ice unicorn. Snowflake sleeps all summer long and wakes up on the first cold day. He breathes out very softly, and the air turns to icy glitter behind him.
falas.8f86d72d: never slips on the ice at Frost. Runs faster on Frost and Night
falas.8ebb95fc: Coco. the beach unicorn. Coco spent so long asleep under the coconut tree that he turned the color of the husk. He knows the exact spot where the waves make the most foam.
falas.9d2dec15: the first bump doesn't hurt him. Runs faster on Beach, Fruit and Autumn
falas.6d2ab159: Comet. the space unicorn. Comet does not know how to stop: he has been crossing the sky since the day he was born. They say that whoever manages to keep up with him gets a wish.
falas.5ebf197b: he jumps three times in the air. Runs faster on Space
falas.c7de52e0: Cherry. the quickest unicorn of all
falas.952c8565: Cherry. the quickest unicorn of all. Cherry does not walk: she swerves. They say she can change lanes twice over before the dust from the first swerve has settled.
falas.dbf3d6d6: she switches lanes much faster. Runs faster on Carnival and Candy
falas.bd9bf0a2: Lemon. the electric unicorn. Lemon is the smallest after Lulu, and he does not sit still for a second. When he jumps you can even hear a little crackle in the air.
falas.2844e63e: he jumps higher than the others. Runs faster on Storm, Fruit and Jungle
falas.9f7e3089: Violet. the smoke unicorn. Violet is a little bit made of smoke: when she leaps she takes her time coming down, as if the air were holding on to her for a moment.
falas.8beafa51: she takes her time coming down from a jump. Runs faster on Mist and Night
falas.46cc6b7f: Crystal. the glass unicorn. Crystal is as clear as a window of ice, and you can watch the rainbow travel right through her when the sun comes in from the side.
falas.8b22d8c9: she is made of glass: you can see right through her. Runs faster on Cave and Frost
falas.fa0749ce: Grandpa. the oldest unicorn. Grandpa has run on every single track, some of them before they even had names. He is not quick to swerve, but his trail covers the whole track.
falas.a71ca12d: turns slowly, but leaves the widest trail. Runs faster on Village and Meadow
falas.2bb606ea: Shadow. the midnight unicorn. Shadow is truly black, without a single thread of color. He glows all on his own, so he never runs in the dark.
falas.b58824e0: he lights himself up on any track. Runs faster on Cave and Volcano
falas.331719d9: Lightning. the storm unicorn. Lightning was born in the crack of a lightning bolt, on a stormy night. The wind that throws everyone else off course does not push him even a little: he cuts straight through the Storm.
falas.a7e2ba0c: the wind at Storm doesn't push him even a little. Runs faster on Storm and Sky
falas.040d44dc: Popcorn. the carnival unicorn. Popcorn lives where the music never stops: between the carousel at the Carnival and the cobbled streets of the Village. Where he goes by it smells of butter, and every heart he finds counts for two.
falas.a561224d: every heart is worth 2 with him. Runs faster on Carnival and Village
falas.a7515711: Pearl. the deep-sea unicorn. Pearl grew up inside a shell, down in the dark at the bottom of the sea. She can see where nobody else can — in the Ocean and in the Mist — and so she finds magic keys that anyone else would have gone straight past.
falas.e88f9aee: magic keys turn up more often with her. Runs faster on Ocean and Mist
falas.003c3b2a: Echo. the unicorn nobody could see
falas.42584ca9: Echo. the unicorn nobody could see. Echo was invisible, and only joy could make him visible. After waiting alone in the tower for so long, he thought that locking everybody up would give him friends — and it only made him sadder. It was Uni who found him. Now he never runs alone again: his echo runs right beside him.
falas.2870ce99: his echo picks up the items in the lane beside him. Runs faster on Mist and Cave
falas.5988b04a: Nobody knows who he is. They say somebody is waiting in the tower in the fog.
falas.fcaac472: Meadow. Where it all began. The grass is soft, the rainbow touches the ground and there are flowers and mushrooms everywhere — the calmest track in the kingdom.
falas.77a3534a: These run faster here: Uni, Moss and Grandpa
falas.d20b2138: Candy. A place made of dessert: lollipops the size of trees, frosted cupcakes and sprinkles falling from the sky. Watch out for the gumdrops in the way.
falas.75f8c58f: These run faster here: Bubblegum and Cherry
falas.5e996838: Village. Cobbled streets between little houses with crooked roofs, lit lanterns and a well in the middle. Here you run slowly and say hello to everybody.
falas.83e1ab9b: These run faster here: Grandpa and Popcorn
falas.ab2758ee: These run faster here: Sunny, Lulu and Lightning
falas.be20933f: Fruit. An orchard with no end: orange trees heavy with fruit, strawberries the size of bushes and bananas fallen in the grass. It smells of ripe fruit all the time.
falas.931ae543: These run faster here: Sunny, Coco and Lemon
falas.88779a0b: Beach. Warm sand, striped parasols and little castles somebody forgot to finish. The sea is right there, making its noise.
falas.1d0236ba: These run faster here: Wave and Coco
falas.58407ef5: Ocean. A sandy path along the bottom of the sea, between corals and swaying seaweed. The fish stop to watch whoever goes by.
falas.7be0942a: These run faster here: Wave and Pearl
falas.0eb512f8: Night. The forest after everybody has gone to sleep. The mushrooms light up on their own, the stars hang very low and the silence keeps you company.
falas.557544a7: These run faster here: Luna, Ember, Star, Snowflake and Violet
falas.18b00440: Frost. Snow falling slowly, white pine trees and a snowman nobody knows who made. The ground is slippery: careful.
falas.e170574f: These run faster here: Luna, Snowflake and Crystal
falas.ba2e5c00: Volcano. Black rock with lit cracks underneath. Embers come up from the ground and the air shimmers with heat — only the brave run here.
falas.6b9a90c8: These run faster here: Ember and Shadow
falas.6d33ff33: Carnival. The fair never closes: striped tents, the big wheel turning and the smell of cotton candy. The carousel music plays the whole time.
falas.2575fa4b: These run faster here: Cherry and Popcorn
falas.a681d461: Space. No ground and almost no weight — a jump takes its time coming down. Planets drift by far away and a flying saucer peeks in now and then.
falas.da943127: These run faster here: Star and Comet
falas.3920ca42: Storm. Rain coming in sideways, puddles reflecting a lead-grey sky and a windmill turning by itself. Every so often a bolt tears through everything.
falas.c583de36: These run faster here: Lemon and Lightning
falas.ef319908: Mist. The fog is so thick that the path only shows up just in time. Lanterns float with nobody holding them, and they say there is a tower somewhere inside.
falas.aabf813c: These run faster here: Violet and Pearl
falas.ae9f3c4b: These run faster here: Violet, Pearl and Echo
falas.5646bb9c: Cave. Deep underground, where the crystals light up on their own and the puddles shine. Every step echoes twice.
falas.1268a5ff: These run faster here: Crystal and Shadow
falas.ebc99606: These run faster here: Crystal, Shadow and Echo
falas.aa3f1ff1: Autumn. The trees change color and drop their leaves slowly, laying down an orange and gold carpet. The air smells of pumpkin and wet ground — the coziest track in the kingdom.
falas.7d101d74: These run faster here: Sunny and Coco
falas.3904a0ae: Jungle. Thick jungle, vines hanging down and thick roots spread across the ground. Parrots shriek from branch to branch, and no one ever tells the same story about it twice.
falas.87595e06: These run faster here: Moss and Lemon
falas.fcd2f15e: The Magic Lands. Far, far away from here there is a kingdom where the sky is pink and the rainbow touches the ground. Every unicorn in the world lived there, running together all day long.
falas.452fb4ee: The quiet morning. One morning Uni woke up and could not hear a soul. Not one gallop, not one laugh. She called for her friends until the sun went down — but the Magic Lands were empty.
falas.210ba8cd: The first key. In the middle of the grass, something little was shining. It was a golden key, warm to the touch, turning all by itself in the air. Uni came closer — and the key shone brighter.
falas.c1451f65: The rainbow's secret. The rainbow bent down low and told her the secret: every friend was behind a locked door. And every door asks for its own number of keys — a few for some, a great many for others.
falas.0bfa48e8: Run, run, run!. The keys were scattered across the tracks of the kingdom, and they only appeared for whoever ran fast. So Uni took a deep breath, opened her wings… and off she went.
falas.57524a4a: One key, one friend. Sunny's door asked for four keys. Uni collected all four, turned the lock… and out he ran to hug her! Then came Luna, whose door asked for six. And little by little the kingdom turned colorful again.
falas.5ccd0bb2: But who did it?. And there is still one thing for Uni to find out: who locked her friends away? Nobody knows. They say the answer lives up there, in the tower in the fog — and that it only opens on the day the very last friend steps out from behind his door.
falas.d7266f79: You're the one we're missing!. So many friends locked away, so many paths shut and a mystery up in the tower — and Uni cannot do it on her own. Run with her, collect the keys, win the levels… and bring everybody home. Shall we?
falas.3addd68b: What nobody could see. Echo lived inside. He was invisible, and only joy could make him visible. He thought that locking everybody up would give him friends — and it only made him sadder. So he scattered the keys, so that Uni, who is joy itself, would come and find him.
